Own profile: the Upload / Follow style buttons and links use Blue #2D7FF9, not TikTok red.

checks.verdictNote: TikTok 47.6.3, Hushfeed 0.80.0 main 8a626029d patched with Accent color Blue, S22: own profile Upload button samples #2D7FF9 (99.4% of its fill), the follow plus under a feed avatar #2D7FF9, the Inbox unread badge #2D7FF9. No primary button or red text in either shot is TikTok red. The only #FE2C55 left is the trophy icon on an NFL 2026 event anchor, an icon rather than a button. The review text says the follow plus and the Inbox badge stay red; on this build both are Blue.
